$comment: lg-yatabase — LangGraph Server config. Marketing + sales graphs for yatabase.gftd.ai (ADR-2605080600 L3 runtime, ADR-2605082100 checkpointer). 100% OSS — no LANGSMITH_API_KEY required. Mirrors lg-narou shape.

checkpointer.$comment: RW PG :4566 direct via _RwAsyncPostgresSaver subclass. Schema lg_yatabase_checkpoint.

crons.$comment: marketing top-of-funnel — every 6 hours UTC. Discover/enrich/score, draft outreach (queued, human-gated).
sales mid/bottom-funnel — every 1 hour UTC. Per-org health + decide_action (drafts queued, human-gated).
BMC lean iteration — daily 07:00 UTC (16:00 JST). Measure active hypothesis, propose persevere/pivot/kill, update BMC if pivot.

auth.$comment: x-api-key (LG_YATABASE_API_KEY env). Public /xrpc handlers proxied through bpmn-dispatcher; cron path unauthenticated.
